about: The state legislature bills this person sponsored or cosponsored, with their votes on them, from Open States and LegiScan as the local refresh collected them. Written by npm run state:export (scripts/export-state-records.mjs); matched to the alignment questions with npm run state:acts.
name: Christina Bohannan

A resolution honoring the life and service of Representative John Landon.
